title: The Shift Below
invitation: Mara Venn has the lift keeper’s last tally. The numbers disagree.

panels.speaker: Lift keeper
panels.text: I sent the platform down with three harnesses. It came back with three harnesses. I was told to put them out to dry.

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: Ivo took three injured Pokémon down with him. I came in to ask when he’d come back. See where they put his name? Under Equipment.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The League-certified Recovery Service has stamped its open circle over the signature line of Mara’s blank incident form.

choices.label: Ask about the return signal
choices.reply: The keeper admits he rang three times, the signal for a live load. He gives you the duplicate slip he kept under the till. It bears the code R-17.

choices.label: Inspect the lift’s load plate
choices.reply: The empty lift’s dial still reads Full. Mara holds the lantern while you take a rubbing of the plate underneath. It bears the code R-17.

echoes.text: Mara takes out the gate-token rubbing. The lift keeper recognizes the crooked gap in its circle and reaches for the old routing key.
The keeper thanks you for fixing the road signal. Mara asks him to show you the lift plate. The bolt is missing from the same corner.

secret.title: The Missing Quarter
secret.hint: Compare the lift evidence with something saved from the first road.
secret.text: The lift’s open-circle mark matches your gate-token rubbing, turned a quarter clockwise. The mine’s routing key reads: ‘Lower exit. Do not bring to surface.’

title: The Drawer Marked Released
invitation: A clerk has pulled the old field survey and left the drawer open for you.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Mara sets an old field survey beside the current map. The shelter marked on the old print has been painted over on the new one.

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: He taught on Fridays. He’d stop a whole match to show a kid where to switch. His pencil’s still in the drawer.

panels.speaker: Academy clerk
panels.text: I stamped them before lunch. At three I could still see the truck from my desk. Look. Those are my initials too.

choices.label: Hear them out and leave the records
choices.reply: The clerk shuts the drawer and keeps talking. They memorized the number the driver called in. Mara promises to ask the next ranger about it in person.

choices.label: Copy the matching transfer entries
choices.reply: You copy the tag numbers and the destination code L-06. The clerk sees their initials on the sheet and asks Mara to wait until they have gone home before showing it around.

echoes.text: Mara shows the clerk the lift keeper’s slip. Seeing another worker’s signature is what makes them unlock the second drawer.
You lay your rubbing beside a paper release seal. The chipped edge inside the circle matches. The clerk leaves both records on the table.

secret.title: Released Into Custody
secret.hint: Put the mine’s code beside the academy’s copied transfer entries.
secret.text: The R-17 load matches all three animal tags. The paired entries show each Pokémon released on paper and loaded under L-06. Each record has a fourth line for an attending surveyor. Ivo’s is blank.

title: Last Check-In
invitation: The duty ranger has kept a recording they were ordered to erase.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The ranger scrubs the tape back with his thumb. Just after Ivo gives his call sign, something claws at the truck bed.

panels.speaker: Ivo, on the recording
panels.text: Three recoveries loaded. Keep the little one on the warm side. Wait. Why is my tag on the gate?

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Mara reaches past the ranger to stop the tape. Ivo’s mug still sits upside down by the kettle.

choices.label: Take the ranger’s statement
choices.reply: The ranger circles L-06 and signs the call log. ‘Use my name. I heard Ivo ask them to stop the truck. They called back to ask why the gate was still shut.’

choices.label: Check the loading gate
choices.reply: Rainwater fills the truck’s ruts. Mara pulls the paper duplicate from the gatehouse clip. The L-06 waybill says ‘Empty’ over the weight of a full load.

echoes.text: Mara keeps her word and repeats the clerk’s tip out of earshot. The ranger reaches behind the radio for the saved recording.
The ranger checks the code you copied against their call log. Mara folds the clerk’s initials under while the ranger makes a second copy.

secret.title: Four on an Empty Truck
secret.hint: Set the ranger evidence beside the academy’s copied release register.
secret.text: The academy stamped the releases five minutes before Ivo’s check-in. The gate recorded the transfer as empty. The last voice on the dispatch tape counts four live passengers bound for Lakeside.
